news.title: UW’s new Irving & Dorothy Levy Hall welcomes the world
news.summary_en: The transformational hub for the humanities and interpretive social sciences will serve as a center for cultural studies, history, community and more.

news.title: First drug to treat Alexander disease approved by the FDA after three decades of research at UW–Madison
news.summary_en: The drug is the first and only disease-modifying treatment for the rare neurological disease.

news.title: Butterflies in the sky: Badgers explore the world of migrating monarchs
news.summary_en: UW–Madison students helped with butterfly tracking efforts as part of the Lakeshore Nature Preserve's ongoing research initiative.
